mapper.select: SELECT t1.id, t1.api_key_config_id, t3.key_name, t1.model_name, t1.model_display_name, t1.context_window_size, t1.max_output_tokens, t1.model_capabilities, t1.temperature, t1.top_p, t1.is_streaming, t1.supports_vision, t1.status, t1.sort, t1.remark, t1.create_time FROM sys_llm_model_config t1 LEFT JOIN sys_llm_api_key_config t3 ON t1.api_key_config_id = t3.id AND t3.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 AND t1.status = 1 ORDER BY t1.sort, t1.create_time DESC
